decisions.Kwic: 山曰。龍袖拂開全體現。曰師意如何。山曰。象王行處絕狐踪。師於言下大悟拜起而曰。萬古碧潭空界月。再三撈摝始應知。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Fenyang Shanzhao biography. Fenyang Shanzhao is the exact actor who awakens at Shoushan Xingnian's words, bows, and gives his verse; Shoushan is the preceding speaker, not the actor of the awakening.

decisions.Kwic: 良久曰。美食不中飽人喫。便下座。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Jiufeng Qin entry. Jiufeng Qin is the exact hall speaker who pauses, says that fine food does not suit a person who is already full, and descends from the seat; Zhimen Guangzuo is the lineage-header teacher, not this speaker.

decisions.Kwic: 師忽有省。入室陳解。遠云。子作麼生會。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Kaixian Shanxian biography. Kaixian Shanxian is the exact actor who has an insight, enters Deshan Yuan's room, and presents his understanding; the broad Deshan lineage header does not identify the actor as Deshan Xuanjian.

decisions.Kwic: 問四威儀中如何履踐。師曰。鷺鶿立雪。曰恁麼則聞鐘持鉢日上闌干。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Zisheng Shengqin entry. Zisheng Shengqin is the exact respondent who answers the question about proceeding within the four deportments with 'a heron stands in the snow'; the broad Deshan lineage header does not make Deshan Xuanjian the speaker.

decisions.Kwic: 師頌魯祖面壁曰。魯祖三昧最省力。纔見僧來便面壁。若是知心達道人。不在揚眉便相悉。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Liangshan Shanji entry. Liangshan Shanji is the exact verse author who verses Luzu's wall-facing and describes Luzu facing the wall whenever a monk comes; Luzu is the subject of the verse, not the author of this headword-bearing verse turn.

decisions.Kwic: 問如何是佛。師曰。張三李四。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Qixian Chengshi entry. Qixian Chengshi is the exact respondent who answers 'What is Buddha?' with 'Zhang Three, Li Four'; Baizhang Heng is the lineage-header teacher, and Baizhang Huaihai is not this speaker.

decisions.Kwic: 明珠。一言勘破維摩詰。覺聞拊几稱善。後七坐道場。化行海內嗣法者甚眾。住後僧問。如何是佛。師曰。布髮掩泥橫身臥地。曰意旨如何

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Tianyi Yihuai biography. The unnamed group of Dharma heirs denoted by 'those who inherited the Dharma were very many' is the exact grammatical actor of 嗣法. All six attribution rungs, including five parallel witnesses of this biography, preserve only the collective group and do not name its members; Tianyi is the biography subject and Xuedou Chongxian is his teacher, not the actor of inheriting here.

decisions.Kwic: 百骸俱潰散一物鎮長靈。如何是一物。師曰。苦哉佛陀耶。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Fengqi Zhongqing entry. An unnamed monk is the exact questioner who asks what the one thing is; all six attribution rungs, including parallel occurrences of the formula and the unique full exchange, leave this questioner unnamed. Fengqi Zhongqing gives the following answer, while Xuedou Chongxian is only the lineage-header teacher.

decisions.Kwic: 師曰。還會麼。居士忽然省悟。有頌云。心鏡從來瑩。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Yunfeng Yuanyi entry. The personally named layman Li Linzong is the exact actor who suddenly awakens after Yunfeng Yuanyi asks whether he understands and then gives a verse; Xuedou Chongxian is only the lineage-header teacher.

decisions.Kwic: 欲明向上事。須具頂門眼。若具頂門眼。始契出家心。既契出家心。常具頂門眼。要會頂門眼麼。四京人著衣喫飯。兩浙人飽暖自如。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Lushan Fazhen entry. Lushan Fazhen, styled Wuxiang in the source, is the exact hall speaker who says one must possess the eye at the crown of the head and asks whether the assembly wants to understand it; the roster name Wuxiang denotes a different person.

decisions.Kwic: 師說法格外作用不守規轍脫略窠臼。至於室中機緣尤為嶮峻不可湊泊。

Decision.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Xiatang Huiyuan biography. Xiatang Huiyuan is the exact biographical subject whose speaking is described as unconventional and whose room encounters are said to be especially steep and impossible to approach; Yuanwu Keqin is his named teacher, not the actor of this clause.
